g.text: Variant 00 of each family · top view · person walks left to right at 1.5 m/s
Black: walls, 6 m high and 0.5 m thick, extending 40 m behind the person.
Coral: the 12 s event window (4–16 s); dotted: the rest of the walk. Soft coral: baseline start box.
Star: the person at t = 0. Turns are centred at 10 s; the generator picks their side at random.
